title: Navvi records
description: One item per record: the requested fields (typed when a type was declared), plus _source, the page it came from, and _startUrl, the start URL that produced it.

_source.description: The URL of the page the record was extracted from (a listing's later page, or where a redirect landed).

_startUrl.description: The start URL that produced the record: the listing requested before pagination or redirect. Equals _source on a record-mode row.

overview.title: Records
overview.description: The extracted records with their source page and start URL.
